message.content: {"caption":"Two side-by-side vertical bar charts compare accuracy on SimpleQA and HLE.","description":"The left chart, titled “SimpleQA,” plots Accuracy (%) from 0 to 100 against five systems. Bars descend from Memento at 95.0%, WebSailor at 93.5%, WebDancer at 90.5%, WebThinker at 77.5%, to Deepseek-r1-React at 72.2%. Memento is highest and Deepseek-r1-React is lowest. The right chart, titled “HLE,” plots Accuracy (%) with ticks from 0 to 30 against five systems. Bars descend from GPT-5 at 25.32%, Memento at 24.40%, Gemini-2.5 Pro at 21.64%, o3-high at 20.32%, to o4-mini-high at 18.08%. GPT-5 is highest and o4-mini-high is lowest; Memento is second. Values are printed above the bars.
